principles: Two speeds. The authored tree is shallow and slow: 9 subject classes chosen by kind of subject (formal, physical, living, language-and-mind, society, making, record, learning, spw) plus apparatus dirs (provenance, registries, panels, trails, season). Fast-changing things live in facets, registries, typed edges, calendars and computed panels.

Anti-Wilkins. No directory encodes a facet: level, form, era, season, review and valence exist only as closed-vocabulary particles, so undergrad/masters and history/applications splits disappear from paths. A fourth level appears only where the subject is real (record/carriers/{sound,moving-image,digital}, formal/mathematics/engineering-core, learning/intergenerational-kit, spw/perspectives).

One canonical home per duplicated core. Classical thermodynamics, electromagnetism and statistical mechanics each have one node in physical/physics; transport, control-and-signals and engineering economics each have one node in physical/engineering; SNAREs live in cells/transport-and-signaling. Disciplines reach these by needs edges and keep only a short discipline frame.

Math before engineering. formal/mathematics/engineering-core (calculus and linear algebra, ODE/PDE, probability and statistics, transforms, numerics, optimization) is the root of the bridge DAG that feeds physics, engineering, econometrics, queueing, market reading and computing; the pure ladder restates every theorem's hypotheses.

Closed vocabularies the gate reads. vocabulary.spw declares single-line sets named exactly layer, domain, form, level, review, valence, era, season, claim, depth, lens, probe_kind, relation, event, care, outcome (the keys scripts/analyzers/spw-cut-gate.ts parses). A facet value must recur on at least 2 files and on no more than N/3; domain values double as anchor prefixes.

Facet citation order follows PMEST: Personality = #:domain, Matter = ^concepts.primary, Energy = #:form, Space = declared gap (no region axis; region lives in qualifiers), Time = #:era then #:season. Every index lists leaves in that order.

Three tiers per class (Britannica): the class index is the Propaedia section and carries a ^["ladder"] prerequisite frame on the closed rung set intro -> foundation -> advanced -> graduate -> practitioner; <class>-glossary.spw is the Micropaedia; leaves are the Macropaedia. Ladders live inside indexes, so no basename repeats outside index.spw.

Every keystone claim is a Wikidata-style statement: anchored value + qualifiers (holds, fails, scope, as_of) + a source: link to a #>src_ anchor + rank as #:claim status. Refuted and superseded raw claims keep deprecated rank in provenance/errata-* and inline; the branch file is authoritative when they differ.

Every surface carries receipts and follows the ethics frame. ^"provenance" holds as_of, generator, revised_by, lineage (raw paths as quoted strings), corrections, and a ^["receipts"] frame of event/at/agent/care/outcome; the contract's ethics frame governs attribution, origins, citation integrity, corrections and visible dissent, and #:review never exceeds the highest passing receipt.

Registries are the single home for numbers and bibliography. Each writer package owns registries/quantities/<pkg>.spw and registries/sources/<pkg>.spw with its own namespace (cut, prov, formal, phys, mateng, life, eco, lang, econ, creator, film, media, learn, lab, hosts, spw) so %ns.key handles, #>src_ns_* anchors and p_ns_* probe ids never collide; an unsourced cell stays empty with status verify.

Visible gaps over forced completeness. Every class index carries a ^["gaps"] frame naming predicted empty cells and their expected neighbors; panels/gap-table crosses domain x form and domain x rung (Mendeleev). A gap is information, not a failure.

Authored and computed stay apart. Edges, trails and affinity panels are authored claims; panels/computed-kin and panels/facet-census are generator output (fingerprinted prompts, never claims), following the plan-index precedent the repo already runs; the clustering hybrid stays a proposal.

The season is a facet with a hub. season/ holds the Thu 2026-10-01 -> Mon 2027-01-04 arc (reflection, gathering, crescendo, celebration, reset), a dated calendar whose every cell says fixed|typical|verify, the fiscal-and-academic-year comparison, a cadence that links each branch calendar (film, authorship, broadcast, streaming, academic, horticultural) and a retrospective protocol.

Harm firewall. Physiology, nursing and community-care surfaces are knowledge maps, histories and descriptive parallels with ecological and biological models, never advice: no doses, diets, supplements, protocols or remediation. Quarantined raw files appear only in ^"provenance" lineage and pointer-only rows of provenance/harm-register; they are never a source: for a claim.

Currency is explicit. Platform terms, gift values, royalty rates, guild agreements, guidelines, agency budgets, festival dates and market shares carry as_of and the edition they come from; anything past the writer's verified knowledge is a cell with status verify, never asserted.

Links are typed and downward-safe. ^["edges"] uses the eight relations needs/feeds/grounds/extends/contrasts/analog/supersedes/case_of read from the declaring file; no non-index file links to any index.spw in its own or an ancestor directory (the gate's prefix rule makes the root index unlinkable from leaves); bundles transclude only children's keystone anchors.

Wonder is combinatorial and accountable. Lenses come from the canon six plus declared extensions, depth from the canon five plus four, probe kinds from a closed list; panels/llull-wheel crosses lens x domain x probe kind x era; every probe names the anchor it would update; every cross-domain analogy has a breaks: line.

Internal history is evidence on equal footing. spw/history treats plan cards, the commit gate, editor and CLI arcs, the episodes-only rewrite and this cut's own generation as dossiers paired (trails/paired-cases) with well-known cases; theory files are questions for the owner, never canon edits.

The language reads itself last. spw/ is written in two waves: design studies (language comparisons, theory pressure) and source-read hosts and history first; then a later spw-branch package writes one perspective per practitioner cluster plus familiarity, tokens-and-roles, rendering-and-cli, transforms, inspection-and-ir, contraptions, dialects-and-play, plugin-theory, graph-idioms and theory-questions, citing anchors the other packages have published.

Lineage is pinned in place. The raw shelf .spw/caches/<topic>/ stays where it is (committed in 5acc5545) as the provenance of this cut; nothing is archived or removed. ^"provenance" names raw paths as quoted strings (never ~ refs), and provenance/manifest pins each of the 208 raw files by sha256 at that commit. The owner-authored shelf index and resume note are out of migration scope.

Currency: 2026 guild cycles, TikTok LIVE gates and gift values, KU rates, Edison platform shares, NSF and agency budgets, state reading and phone laws, 2026-27 festival and awards dates and clinical guidelines may have moved past the writers' verified knowledge. They must be cells with status verify, never prose assertions.

Fabricated precision: the raw tree held about 49 invented effect sizes; new timelines, calendars, media histories and contraptions invite invented dates and numbers. A date or number without a src_ link is marked verify or left out; hypotheses state direction, not magnitude.

Contested and personal ground: curriculum wars and public worry about schools, generational labels, and the owner's family story. Positions carry evidence status and poll sources, cohort boundaries are marked interpretive, and the kit never contains the story or third-party personal data.

Speaking for others: the 12 perspectives describe practitioner clusters the writer does not belong to. They are framed as hypotheses about familiar shapes (#!interpretive), avoid stereotyping professions, carry a probe that a member of the cluster would run, and mark review unreviewed until such a reader has looked.
